items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...my name is Dick Allen... [INTERVIEWEE] When you're drumming? When I'm drumming...

ctx.x: You can see that little light and that tells where it's recording. Let's see, we're at 115... 115 West 145th Street. Yes, and my name is Dick Allen, this is my voice, and Danny Barker is the Chief Engineer.

When you're drumming? When I'm drumming, it's a habit I guess. Sometimes I'm very confident I got that stereo to my eyeball look. From your menstrual days? Yeah. I got them menstrual days, what do you call it? T-O-B-A.
